people.Vrishaparva: An asura king; father of Sharmishtha.
people.Maya: Mayasura, the great asura architect; father of Mandodari.

Danu.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of the Danava asuras.

people.Viprachitti: Foremost of the Danava sons of Kashyap and Danu; wed Simhika and fathered Rahu.
people.Namuchi: A Danava son of Danu, slain by Indra with sea-foam.
people.Shambara: A Danava sorcerer-king, son of Danu; foe of Pradyumna.

Danayus.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of fierce Danavas.

Vritra.note: Asura who held back the world's waters; slain by Indra with the thunderbolt Vajra, made from the bones of the sage Dadhichi, who gave them freely for it. In the Bhagavata's own account he is also, at once, the self-realised king Chitraketu reborn under a curse of Parvati's, so that killing him cost Indra nothing spiritually — the being had no fear of death to begin with.

people.Rahu: Son of Viprachitti and Simhika; the severed asura-head that swallows sun and moon at eclipses.

Ketu.note: Severed body of the eclipse-asura, brother of Rahu; the descending shadow-node.

people.Vatapi: Asura son of Simhika who, with Ilvala, preyed on guests until the sage Agastya digested him.
people.Ilvala: Asura son of Simhika; brother of Vatapi.

Atapi.note: Asura brother of Vatapi; the pair who preyed on guests until Agastya digested Vatapi.
